name: Law of Common Fate
axiom: Things that move together in one direction are seen as one thing, whatever else differs.
trigger: A sidebar collapses while its labels reflow at a different speed, so the panel tears.

checklist.text: Animate a menu and its items as one surface, not as a stagger of separate parts.
Give every element of a collapsing panel the same duration and easing curve.
Dismiss table rows along one exit path so the remaining rows move as a block.
Record a slowed transition; any part that arrives late is moving in its own direction.

antiPattern.violation: A sidebar slides left while its child text wraps and drops, so the panel comes apart.
antiPattern.remediation: Sidebar, labels, and icons translate together on one 200 ms curve.

academicOrigin.title: Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II
